comment: Layer C integration cases for fv3_lin_rood_advection. The williamson1_cosine_bell_path_b case exercises solid-body rotation via Path-B (ESM → build_ode_problem → ESS.discretize → solve) using the cubed_sphere_transport.esm which encodes ∂h/∂t = -∂h/∂lon for unit angular velocity on the unit sphere. This is the esd-5ou Path-B route: it does not yet exercise the full Lin-Rood dimensional-split PPM scheme (ESS does not yet dispatch `kind: dimensional_split`; that extension is the dsc-esx follow-up), but proves that the Path-B infrastructure routes solid-body rotation to a working ODE solve on the cubed sphere — the same physical test that williamson1_cosine_bell in ppm_reconstruction/fixtures/integration/ previously exercised via the imperative transport_2d_linrood! call chain. The ppm_reconstruction case is retired (kind changed to stub) once this case is wired.
